title: Who did what, kept for good → client · server · contract
lede: The board below is `apps/team.bl`: people sign in, the server knows who proposes, and every change is written down and survives a restart.
hints: **Identity is the transport's, policy is BL's.** Signing in sets an HttpOnly, SameSite=Strict session cookie; the transport stamps the person on every proposal (a browser cannot send one). Each intent's `:allow` — `can?` in the source — decides on the server; the view runs the same `can?` so it only offers what you may do.

**History is the authority's.** `:history 50` writes every commit to a durable log the server replays at boot, keeps the activity feed in the server's own words, and gives the lead shared **Undo** and **Redo**.
Sign in as different people in two windows: Ben moves his own cards, Dev (a viewer) can only look, Ana (the lead) assigns, deletes and undoes for everyone.
